planned.description: Provenance marker — ticket was generated by ticket-planner. Once set, never removed by any pipeline phase.

INIT-*.description: Wildcard pattern matching initiative IDs (e.g., INIT-42). Links ticket to parent planning initiative. Never removed.

pre-approved.description: Set by planner when confidence >= 0.85. Bypasses human approval gate. Revoked by human-reject or re-claim triggers.

blocked-by:*.description: Wildcard pattern for dependency enforcement (e.g., blocked-by:CRE-100). Auto-removed when the blocking ticket reaches Done.

state:execution.description: Marks an initiative Epic as ready for fleet controller dispatch. Epic-only — flow.sh rejects if added to non-Epic issues.

appraise-start.description: Claim a ticket and begin appraisal

human-reject.description: Human rejected the plan — return to Todo for re-appraisal

pr-review-pass-done.description: PR approved with no UAT required — close to Done

pr-review-pass-uat.description: PR approved with UAT required — move to UAT

pr-review-fail.description: PR review found issues — mark rejected (no state change)

pr-iterate.description: Iterating on PR feedback — return to Ready

uat-fail.description: UAT failed — return to Ready for another pass

needs-info.description: Block ticket — waiting for external information

re-claim.description: Remove approval label to restart gate hold cycle
